name: Press Gang
text: Gain a Deckhand into your discard pile.

name: Lookout
text: Look at the next event and put it back on top or bottom.

name: Customs Man
text: Each rival pays you 1 coin if they can.

name: Fog Lantern
text: Ignore the next Storm that would hit you.

name: Smuggler
text: Gain 3 more coin if a rival owns a Customs House.

name: Pearl Diver
text: Reveal the top card of your deck; gain its coin and timber.

name: Harpooner
text: After the Kraken sinks a building you may rebuild it for half timber.

name: Cartographer
text: Score 1 VP at game end for each building type you own beyond three.
